details.name: MOB.628_Collector_Document_Add_Delete
details.message:
`MOB.628` **Upload ONE PDF to a `DD SYNTHETIC MOBILE` asset's Docs, then delete exactly that file — both ends over `/graphql`.**
- 📄 The upload is the one PDF the owner recorded in the Datadog UI (`MOB.PDF_Upload_Recording`,
  trap 12); locally a generated one-page PDF of the same name.
- ⭐ The server must list the uploaded id as the one attachment that was not there before, with
  the PDF's name and a non-image type.
- 🛑 Delete (owner-authorised 2026-09-15, own upload only): the row's box is checked only when it
  is ours and nothing else is; `Delete File(s)` is clicked in the same step as a re-check that the
  only checked row is ours. ⭐ The id is gone and the set is exactly as before.
- Residue: none when green. Row collapsed and sessionStorage keys removed on the way out.
